summary: Event of the server party system: a party was split and a new party entity created. Made on a fresh event entity by bg3.exe+0x2BBFD20 when the second member of a (party, other) pair is null: the new party comes from bg3.exe+0x2BBBED0, which creates eoc::party::CompositionComponent and esv::party::NewPartyOneFrameComponent on it. Read by esv::FlagManager::OnPartySplitEvent (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x852B80). Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row; not flagged one-frame).
